collection.title: Audi RS3 2015 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi RS3 Saloon 2015 - 2021 which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
